title: aside
description: The next piece of the answer to the session.aside asideId: seq counts from 1 per aside, text is at most 4 KiB (cut on a character boundary). Sent only on the connection that asked, every one before that aside's reply. It carries no subscription and no event seq: it is none of the session's events, and is never sequenced or journalled. A host whose connection is not reading stops sending an aside's notices once 1 MiB of them wait; the reply's text is the whole answer, so a client may drop them, and drops those of an aside it stopped waiting for. A client that does not know it ignores it.
